rows.grounds: numeral indicating a set of eight
compound with internal sandhi: siddhisaṃprāptiḥ + mūlakaulam

items.question: What constitutes the root Kaula practice alongside the eight attainments of powers?
premises: Eight attainments of powers are enumerated.
These attainments are identified as the root Kaula.
The teaching is addressed to the fair-faced goddess.
items.inference: The attainment of the eight powers together constitutes the fundamental Kaula practice.
uncertainties: The specific eight powers are not named in this verse and rely on prior context.
items.plain_english: And the attainment of the eight powers is the root Kaula, O fair-faced one.
